استجنسوا (form X)
# اِسْتَجْنَسُوا (istajnasū) /is.tad͡ʒ.na.suː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَجْنَسَ (istajnasa)
# اُسْتُجْنِسُوا (ustujnisū) /us.tud͡ʒ.ni.suː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَجْنَسَ (istajnasa)
# اِسْتَجْنِسُوا (istajnisū) /is.tad͡ʒ.ni.suː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَجْنَسَ (istajnasa)
